title: Presentation artifact wire contract
description: The wire data contract for a generated presentation artifact (presentation_layer.md §6), complete on day one per decision D: narrative and metrics are typed here and stubbed by the export driver (P5), not added at P20/P21a. Contract rules encoded mechanically: floats are always JSON numbers, never formatted strings; null means "not computed", never zero; structurally-constant fields are omitted, never shipped null (RankedVeto declares neither veto_sensitivity nor top_vetos and closes additionalProperties so a reshaping bug that re-includes either fails validation).

Artifact.description: Top-level artifact, written atomically by the export driver (§5.3).

model_version.description: git SHA of the training run.

intervals_present.description: Derived — did D10's auto-load find bootstrap replicates?

Knobs.description: The prediction knobs that produced this artifact, so a reader can tell what produced a number (self-describing artifact rule).

MetricsSummary.description: Headline evaluation numbers for the methodology page. Loosely-typed at P1 (decision D): P5 emits a stub object and P21a populates the real fields later without a schema change, so no properties are declared and additionalProperties is permitted.

Fixture.description: One upcoming fixture's self-contained prediction record (§6; self-contained so a future per-fixture-file split is mechanical). The allOf below pins series_probabilities — both the overall result's and every ranked veto's — and outcome_order to length best_of_int + 1 (2, 4, 6 for Bo1, Bo3, Bo5).

bo5_unvalidated.description: Derived (§4.6) — Bo5 is structurally supported but empirically unvalidated at v1.

outcome_order.description: The best_of + 1 terminal (a_wins, b_wins) scorelines in canonical order, hoisted once per fixture (§4.5) rather than repeated per ranked entry; length best_of_int + 1, enforced by the Fixture-level allOf.

scoreline_labels.description: Derived display labels, parallel to outcome_order (same length; enforced by validate_artifact in Python, since draft-07 JSON Schema cannot express cross-field length parity).

coverage_mass.description: Derived — Σ veto_probability over the top-N listing.

narrative.description: Deterministic template narrative (§10); P5 emits "" until P20/P21a fill it (decision D).

Team.description: One side of a fixture: the stable team_id plus the derived display name.

OverallResult.description: The top level of predict()'s PredictionResult, after §4.5 reshaping.

series_probabilities.description: The best_of + 1 scoreline probabilities in outcome_order order (M31 sampled); length best_of_int + 1, enforced by the Fixture-level allOf.

per_map.description: The greedy veto's played maps, in play order.

greedy_veto.description: The 7-step greedy veto; not displayed by default (§2).

greedy_rank.description: Derived — the greedy veto's 1-based rank among top_vetos, or null when the greedy veto is not in the displayed top-N (or the alternative §2 display is not chosen). Accepts both number and null per §6.

VetoSensitivity.description: The structural (M37) spread summary across the sampled veto sequences.

mean_band_width.description: The scalar headline: mean of band_widths.

RankedVeto.description: One entry of the top-N exact veto listing. Structurally-constant fields are omitted, not shipped null (§4.5/§6): this type declares neither veto_sensitivity (always null here, G6) nor a nested top_vetos (always [] here, G1), and additionalProperties is closed so a reshaping bug that re-includes either field fails validation.

rank.description: Derived — 1-based position in the top-N listing.

veto_probability.description: Exact joint probability of this enumerated sequence.

actions.description: The 7 veto steps, in step order.

per_map.description: This veto's played maps, in play order.

series_probabilities.description: The exact M30 recursion scoreline distribution; length best_of_int + 1, enforced by the Fixture-level allOf.

favorite_flips.description: Derived — opposite side of 0.5 from the overall p_a_wins_series.

VetoAction.description: One step of a veto sequence.

team_name.description: The acting team's derived display name (resolved by P3).

PerMap.description: One played map's prediction. Probability/interval vectors are exactly length 4 in fixed OUTCOME_LABELS order (A-regulation, A-OT, B-OT, B-regulation); a null interval means "not computed", never a fabricated [0,0,0,0].

probabilities.description: The four temperature-scaled map-outcome probabilities in OUTCOME_LABELS order.

interval_low.description: The four per-category lower band endpoints in the same order; null means not computed (no bootstrap replicates), never zero.

interval_high.description: The four per-category upper band endpoints in the same order; null alongside interval_low.

n_games_backing.description: min(games_a, games_b) — the weaker side's as-of, map-specific game count.

MapLeverage.description: One map's veto-leverage attribution (§5.4), ranked by |swing| × p_played.

n_vetos_backing.description: How many top-N entries played this map.
